title: A package close leaves a leg's still-working Alpaca entry order resting; it fills later as an orphan
note: 2026-11-25 MEASURED (alpaca_order_history alpaca_options_paper, by_id f48416cd; trader journal 17:05-18:25Z). slv_trend_1h pkg-d3d7898d93b042c1: leg 8569 on alpaca_options_paper had DAY mleg limit entry f48416cd (put debit spread SLV261231P35/P34, limit 0.41) WORKING from 15:30:31Z. 17:11:35Z sl_cross verdict -> close_open_position 'no open position (idempotent)' -> row 8569 closed (exit 35.535, pnl null). NOTHING cancelled f48416cd. It FILLED 18:11:05Z (0.40). 18:11:47Z the reconciler adopted both option legs as orphans 8612/8613; 18:13:50-52Z _reattach_adopted_orphans flattened them (market 1.58 / 1.88). Balance 100000.00 -> 99989.90. Paper only. Live relevance: any Alpaca leg whose entry is a working LIMIT (not market) closed before fill leaves a live entry order. FIX: when a close finds 'no open position' and the row's broker_order_id is still working (new/accepted/partially_filled), cancel that entry order (own-order id only) and journal the row cancelled/unfilled, not closed with an exit price. Closing observation: the next package close with a working entry order cancels it and no orphan is adopted on that symbol.
